QuestInfo.0: The sinkhole has started to change since #b#p1531008##k vanished into it. You'll need to reach Lv. 100 through further training. Go speak to #b#p1531011##k to find out what would be the best way to train. \r\n
QuestInfo.1: #b#p1531011##k happens to be located in a place that needs to be checked out. Go check out Aqua Road and report any strange findings.
QuestInfo.2: You discovered a piece of a building that looks to be from Seoul, just sitting around Aqua Road. You're not sure what happened, but it could still be dangerous. Ask #b#p1531011##k what to do.\r\n#b(Use the lightbulb on the left to accept Three Moon's next quest.)#k
